title: 11 Best Herbal Tinctures For Ear Blockage
intro: Herbal tinctures for ear blockage are concentrated liquid extracts of plants used to treat ear congestion, ear fullness, and impaired hearing caused by blockages in the ear canal. These tinctures have been traditionally used to alleviate ear blockage symptoms, offering several benefits, including promoting ear drainage, reducing inflammation, and enhancing the body's natural healing processes. Effective herbal tinctures for ear blockage include Garlic tincture, which helps to reduce bacterial and fungal infections, Onion tincture, which possesses natural anti-inflammatory properties, and Mullein tincture, which soothes and calms the ear canal. Other herbal tinctures, such as Echinacea, Goldenseal, and Olive leaf, are also commonly used to treat ear blockage due to their antimicrobial and antiviral properties, which help to combat underlying infections and promote ear health.
